per_category_oracle.description: Validation-only post-hoc aggregate using each category's Dice-selected threshold on the same val200 findings.

selection_rule.primary: maximum category mean global Dice per finding

warnings: Thresholds were selected and evaluated on the same val200 set; the per-category oracle is optimistic and is not a submission policy.
Category 2f has no val200 findings, so no category-specific threshold can be estimated.
Category 2g has one val200 finding; its selected threshold is descriptive and not reliable.
